# Arthur De Witte (Arthurdw)

> Personal website and blog of Arthur De Witte, a full-stack freelance software engineer from Belgium. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Applied Computer Science (Software Engineering) from HOWEST University of Applied Sciences, graduated magna cum laude, and works mainly with Rust, TypeScript (Vue/Nuxt, Svelte/SvelteKit) and DevOps tooling (Docker, Terraform, Ansible).

The blog covers events, conferences, company visits and projects from his studies and career. Most posts are in English; posts marked (Dutch) are written in Dutch.

## About

- [About me](https://arthurdw.com/intro.html): Background, current tech stack, notable projects (Pincer, Firefly, Xiler DNS, IrefIndex), whitepaper and contact details
